description: This file contains extension methods for CanvasWindowController, providing helper functions for sanitizing session keys, encoding strings as JavaScript literals, managing stored frame states through UserDefaults, and restoring window frames.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: An extension adding helper methods related to session key sanitization, JavaScript string encoding, and window frame persistence for CanvasWindowController.

methods.name: sanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Sanitizes a session key string by trimming whitespace and replacing invalid characters with underscores. Defaults to 'main' if the trimmed string is empty.

methods.name: jsStringLiteral
methods.description: Encodes a given string as a JSON-compatible JavaScript string literal.

methods.name: jsOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Encodes an optional string as a JavaScript string literal, returning 'null' if the value is nil.

methods.name: storedFrameDefaultsKey
methods.description: Generates a UserDefaults key for storing frame information based on a session key.

methods.name: loadRestoredFrame
methods.description: Retrieves and reconstructs an NSRect from UserDefaults for a given session key, ensuring minimum size constraints.

methods.name: storeRestoredFrame
methods.description: Stores an NSRect (window frame) into UserDefaults for a given session key.
